Materializing frankenphp-bin from local mirror... Materialized frankenphp-bin Analyzing frankenphp-bin AUR package with openrouter/free Performing initial audit of PKGBUILD to ensure that we can safely run `makepkg` LLM auditresponse for PKGBUILD: SAFE

The PKGBUILD's top-level scope only defines variables: pkgname, pkgver, pkgrel, url, source, source_prefix, and the architecture-specific source_* arrays. There are no top-level command substitutions, function calls, or side effects that execute during sourcing.

The actual installation logic resides entirely within the package() function, which is never executed during makepkg --printsrcinfo. The sha256sums entries are set to SKIP, which is a legitimate packaging practice and carries no risk at this parsing step since no sources are downloaded or verified when printsrcinfo runs. No data exfiltration, obfuscated code, or unexpected network requests occur in the top-level scope.

Top-level PKGBUILD only sets variables; no malicious execution during sourcing. + Initial PKGBUILD audit complete -- Top-level PKGBUILD only sets variables; no malicious execution during sourcing. Note: 3 remote source(s) have no checksum (sha256sums=SKIP), so the bytes are not verifiable: LICENSE::https://raw.githubusercontent.com/php/frankenphp/refs/tags/v1.13.2/LICENSE, frankenphp-1.13.2-x86_64::https://github.com/php/frankenphp/releases/download/v1.13.2/frankenphp-linux-x86_64, frankenphp-1.13.2-aarch64::https://github.com/php/frankenphp/releases/download/v1.13.2/frankenphp-linux-aarch64 Reviewing the 3 file(s) in the AUR repository. Reviewing the AUR repository's files... [0/3] Reviewing .SRCINFO... [0/3] Reviewing .SRCINFO, .gitignore... [0/3] Reviewing .SRCINFO, .gitignore, PKGBUILD... LLM auditresponse for PKGBUILD: SAFE
This is a standard AUR -bin PKGBUILD for frankenphp-bin. It downloads prebuilt binaries and the LICENSE file from the package's own upstream GitHub repository (php/frankenphp) using the declared pkgver. The package() function simply installs the binary to /usr/bin and the license to the standard licenses directory. All sha256sums are set to SKIP with a maintainer note explaining that upstream blobs change after release; per AUR packaging norms, SKIP checksums alone are not evidence of malice. There are no obfuscated commands, no eval/base64/curl|bash patterns, no network exfiltration, and no modifications to unrelated system files. The behavior is consistent with ordinary prebuilt binary packaging.
Standard -bin PKGBUILD fetching official upstream binaries; no malicious behavior detected. [1/3] Reviewing .SRCINFO, .gitignore... + Reviewed PKGBUILD. Status: SAFE -- Standard -bin PKGBUILD fetching official upstream binaries; no malicious behavior detected. LLM auditresponse for .SRCINFO: SAFE
The `.SRCINFO` file contains standard package metadata and references only the project’s declared upstream repository on GitHub. It downloads architecture-specific FrankenPHP release binaries and the corresponding license for version 1.13.2. The `SKIP` checksums mean the downloaded files are not integrity-verified during packaging, which is a supply-chain hygiene concern, but it is not itself evidence of malicious behavior. No unexpected hosts, obfuscated commands, data exfiltration, or unrelated system modifications are present.
